overview_description.description:
Toss is a South Korea-based mobile financial service platform operated by fintech startup Viva Republica.

Its application offers peer-to-peer money transfers, manages credit scores and bank accounts, access loan and insurance plans, split bill options, QR payment and other similar services that enable users to manage their finance.

Toss was established in 2011 by Seunggun Lee in Seoul, Seoul-t'ukpyolsi.

product.name: Toss Financial Super App
product.description: A mobile financial management platform that consolidates accounts, cards, balances, loans, investments, income, and spending in one interface.

product.name: Toss Money Management
product.description: A personal finance management service for tracking linked account balances, card activity, income, expenses, loans, and investments.

product.name: Toss Transfers
product.description: A mobile money transfer service for sending funds between users and bank accounts, with scheduled transfers and transfer-time fraud-account checks.

product.name: Toss Payments (Consumer)
product.description: A digital payment service for making online and offline purchases in South Korea and abroad, with support for coupons, points, and membership rewards.

product.name: Toss Lending Comparison
product.description: A loan comparison service that lets users review borrowing limits and interest rates from multiple banks for credit, emergency, refinancing, and mortgage loans.

product.name: Toss Credit Management
product.description: A consumer credit service for viewing KCB and NICE credit scores, submitting information that may improve scores, receiving change alerts, and accessing credit guidance.
